commenti.body:
I think you're not quite understanding the relation of the film to a lot of incels/men's rights people. Whatever the film's actual statements on materialism, what is "masculine", etc., they have taken Tyler as inspiration for their political agenda. 

Whatever the filmmakers have intended is kind of irrelevant here, it's how the film is interpreted.

I understand that it's been coopted, just like many other things have been coopted.

But I'm talking about the film itself here only.
